mr-asha-01: Aarz, Sunita Pawar, Anchaqare, Gruha Baiddhili, Tansevai Chowis Varshehahe, Gav Vardga, Garodharpana, Atavis, Atvurizhali, Ahe, Bibi, Akshavis, Bai Shiahe, Vazan, Bavanna Kilo.
mr-asha-02: Rekha Zadav, Waikon Tis, Gau Shirud, Mubai Lambar, Nau Ardon, Tinshyaar, Palshaar, Saat Ardon, Nau, Sulaatav De Purna Saale, Imoglubin Saade Dahaha hai, Lohachak Tis, Goya Diyah.
mr-asha-03: Mangle Shinde, Nchita Pasnayi keri, Vy Bhattis Varshe, Gau Pimple Gau, Chatti Satavle, Zalini, Vypi, Xicharis Bhai Novar, Vyadhan Sat Kilo, Purchi Bhair, Bhair, Bhair, Vyamberla.
